boundaries: The Method defines how measurement is performed; the Result records what one execution produced.
Corrections create successor Results while preserving the original record and evidence.
Interpretation, acceptance, and use in a Finding remain separate governed acts.
claim_ceiling: This candidate defines Measurement Result for Step 3 review only and has no admission or downstream activation effect.
residue_refs: Artifact Type rebinding and admission remain separate.

scope.applicability: A Measurement Result is an immutable attributable record of one exact Measurement Method execution against one exact subject revision under declared conditions, preserving values, units, uncertainty, raw evidence, Tool and Implementation versions, timestamps, validity posture, owner, and receipt.
exclusions: It is not the Measurement Method, subject, Observation narrative, Evidence Set, Finding, causal claim, Decision, accepted fact, or authority effect.
A value without exact Method, subject, conditions, units, uncertainty, and provenance is not a conforming Measurement Result.
This Definition does not admit a carrier, instance, relation, runtime, consumer, publication, or deployment.

examples: result:residue-entropy:run-44 records 0.37 bits for experiment-run:44 using method:residue-entropy/v2, its raw register digest, computation receipt, and ±0.02 uncertainty.
